sources.title: Captainsl/SinhalaLLM · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model is a SmolLM2-1.7B base model fine-tuned on Sinhala text (MADLAD_CulturaX_cleaned). Finetuning method: 4-bit LoRA finetuning via Unsloth + PEFT; final artifact merged into a standard HF model.

sources.title: README.md · Captainsl/SinhalaLLM at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model represents an undergraduate research attempt to adapt SmolLM2-1.7B for Sinhala language generation. Part of thesis: "Developing a Fluent Sinhala Language Model: Enhancing AI's Cultural and Linguistic Adaptability" (NSBM Green University, 2025).
